paragraphs.text: Jorilin was a city in Yotia during the Brothers' War on Dominaria .

Jorilin was a coastal city, and fishing was its main industry. Tawnos was born in Jorilin, and his uncles had some involvement with the fishing trade. Tawnos learned fishing when he was very young, but he eventually developed a keen skill and interest in artifacts , which estranged him from his uncles. After the Statue Trial of Kroog when Urza became the Chief Artificer of Yotia, Tawnos left Jorilin behind and traveled to Kroog , Yotia's capital.

It is not known what happened to Jorilin during the war itself, but it was likely sacked after the Fall of Kroog . Eventually, the land where Jorilin was located would be inundated in the Flooding of Terisiare , and submerged beneath the Sea of Laments .
